record.name: Intercom
record.one_liner: Customer support and communication platform with inbox, tickets, help center, and developer APIs
record.access_note: You can create a free developer workspace and app in the Intercom Developer Hub to obtain an access token.
record.api_note: The REST API covers contacts, conversations, tickets, companies, help center articles, admins, and data events.

evidence.quote: To access the Intercom API, you have two authentication options depending on whether you app is public or private.
You can create a new developer workspace for developing apps. Developer workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.

Intercom hosts a remote MCP server that follows the authenticated remote MCP specification
